import collections

def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]; h=len(a); w=len(a[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for row in a for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=a[r][c]
        if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and a[yy][xx]==color:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
        r0=min(y for y,x in comp); r1=max(y for y,x in comp); c0=min(x for y,x in comp); c1=max(x for y,x in comp)
        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        perimeter={(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1) if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
        if set(comp)!=perimeter: continue
        if all(a[y][x]==bg for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)):
          ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
          fill=2 if ih%2==0 and iw%2==0 else 7
          for y in range(r0+1,r1):
            for x in range(c0+1,c1): a[y][x]=fill
    return a
